## MCSWE change

Type (pick one):
- [ ] Definitions: decisions, requirements, interfaces (stages 1 to 3)
- [ ] Implementation of merged definitions (stages 4 and 5)
- [ ] Amendment
- [ ] Emergency: trigger is <outage | data loss | security exposure | harm to people>

Requirements covered: REQ-

## Checklist

- [ ] Definitions for this work were merged before this change (implementation only)
- [ ] Every unit added or changed in scope carries a `TRACEABILITY_MAPPING:` anchor
- [ ] Every new test names its requirements
- [ ] Audit run on this commit; record: `docs/mcswe/audits/<commit>.yaml`
- [ ] Trace matrix regenerated, not hand-edited

## Approval

- [ ] Independent reviewer (did not write any part of this change)
- [ ] Self-approval (O4.4): no independent reviewer was available
